release_notes: Build 164 adopts the approved Factburst Quiz Manager light management UI as the centralized desktop visual baseline: light shell, clean navigation, white cards, restrained borders and consistent typography.
Build 164 keeps API credentials and settings persistence untouched while applying the visual baseline during shell construction.
Build 164 updates the batch-render regression test to validate the dedicated STA rendering runner used by the current release pipeline.
Build 164 fixes credential recovery test fixtures so valid SQLite databases are used and installed database state is verified as preserved.
Build 163 passed the GitHub C# and website test workflows before release packaging.
Build 161 fixes Quiz Release Automation freezing by moving WPF card, visual re-export and thumbnail rendering to a dedicated STA worker thread instead of the desktop UI dispatcher.
Build 161 keeps audio timeline augmentation, FFmpeg work and file publishing off the UI thread.
Build 157 configuration backup recovery and Build 156 database credential recovery remain intact.
